query: UPDATE meta_messaging_attachment SET status='stored',lease_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE connection_id=$1 AND provider_message_id=$2 AND ordinal=$3 AND lease_id=$4 AND lease_until>now() AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_message m WHERE m.connection_id=$1 AND m.provider_message_id=$2 AND m.provenance<>'macro_reply' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM meta_messaging_revision r WHERE r.connection_id=m.connection_id AND r.customer_id=m.customer_id AND r.provider_message_id=m.provider_message_id AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.deleted_at IS NOT NULL))
